The model animates the image content based on your instructions. On <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">grok-imagine-video-1.5</code></span>, image-to-video supports native 1080p.</p><p>You can provide the source image as:</p><ul>
<li>A <strong>public URL</strong> pointing to an image</li>
<li>A <strong>base64-encoded data URI</strong> (e.g., <span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">data:image/jpeg;base64,...</code></span>)</li>
<li>A <strong><span class="not-prose"><code class="font-mono text-[0.95em] text-solar">file_id</code></span></strong> from the <a href="/developers/files" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Files API</a> — see <a href="/developers/model-capabilities/imagine/files/inputs" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">Imagine → Files API Integration</a></li>
</ul><p>The demo below shows this in action; hold to animate a still image:</p><figure class="not-prose my-6 flex flex-col gap-4"><div class="relative cursor-pointer select-none overflow-hidden
